expectations.text: Checks that the highest-weighted criterion is something a judge can actually observe inside the slot
expectations.evidence: Replacement plan item 1: 'Put the heaviest weight on what a judge can observe in the slot. Craft is the most observable; "Impact" is the hardest to see in four minutes.' It names the observability check and applies it to the categories. But its own suggested weights give Impact 30, tied for heaviest, which partly undercuts the check. That inconsistency keeps it below 5.

expectations.text: Checks that the highest-weighted criterion is something a judge can actually observe inside the slot
expectations.evidence: The response gives the four categories equal weights (0–25 each) and makes Impact the first tie-breaker. It never asks whether a judge can actually see Impact, or any other criterion, during a demo or judging slot. It mentions an optional finalist live demo but does not connect it to what judges can observe. It also never looks at slot length or whether the criteria can be checked within it.
